examples.arabic: قررت ليلى أن تذهب للتسوق اليوم، فقد كانت بحاجة إلى فستان جديد وبعض الأغراض للمنزل.
examples.english: Layla decided to go shopping today, as she was in need of a new dress and some household items.
examples.transliteration: Qarrarat Layla an tadhaba lil-tasawwuq al-yawm, faqad kanat bi-hajetin ila fustan jadid wa ba'd al-aghrad lil-manzil.

examples.arabic: بتمنى ألاقي فستان حلو بيناسب مناسبة أخي الشهر الجاي، ويكون سعره منيح إلي.
examples.english: I hope I find a nice dress that suits my brother's occasion next month, and its price is good for me.
examples.transliteration: Batamanna alaa'i fustan hilu biyenasib munasabat akhi ish-shahr il-jay, w yakoun si'ruh mneeh illi.

examples.english: This blue dress is very small
examples.transliteration: Had el fustan el azraq kteer sghir
examples.storyTitle: A Visit to the Shop with My Sister

examples.english: The white dress is very beautiful and long.
examples.transliteration: al fustan al abyad hilo ktir wa tawil

examples.arabic: وفي مرة كان عندها فستان احمر
examples.english: And a woman had a red dress
examples.transliteration: Wi fii mara kaan 'andaha fustaan aḥmar

examples.arabic: ماما قالتلي مساء الخير يا بنتي بدنا نرجع هاد الفستان للمحل
examples.english: Mom told me, "Good evening, my daughter, we need to return this dress to the shop."
examples.transliteration: Mama qālatli masāʾ al-khayr ya binti badna narjiʿ hād il-fustān lil-maḥall
